systems.system: Comissao Nacional de Protecao de Dados (CNPD)

CPV.note: The CNPD subscribed to a joint declaration of data authorities; it is regulator guidance with no stated legal effect and no AI-specific mandate.
The document says nothing on AI use in public administration.
The document says nothing on AI in a sector's public system.
The document says nothing on AI models, datasets or computing built in the country.
